content.title: Nucor shares drop as fourth quarter earnings miss estimates
content.summary: Investing.com -- Nucor Corp (NYSE:NUE) reported fourth quarter adjusted earnings of $1.73 per share, falling short of analyst expectations of $1.86, while revenue came in at $7.69 billion, below the consensus estimate of $7.87 billion. The steel producer’s shares dropped 3.2% in after-hours trading Monday following the earnings miss.
